tutorial.step1.title: Welcome to Facebook AI!
tutorial.step1.content: This is a quick tour to get you started. You're using a demo account, but the trading data is real. If this were a real account with your own funds, any profits could be withdrawn.
tutorial.step2.title: Choose Your Robot
tutorial.step2.content: First, select one of the AI trading robots. Each has a different strategy, from low-risk to high-growth. Your choice will determine the trading behavior.
tutorial.step3.title: Start Trading
tutorial.step3.content: Once you've selected a robot, press the 'Start Trading' button. The robot will begin to execute trades automatically based on its strategy.
tutorial.step4.title: You're All Set!
tutorial.step4.content: The robot is now trading. You can watch the trade history fill up in real-time. You can stop or change the robot at any time. Good luck!
